name: Screenpipe
tagline: Screen and audio history for AI assistants
description: Captures screen text and audio into a local history that coding assistants can search through an authenticated MCP server.
approachDetail: Timestamped screen text, transcripts and memories in local SQLite, with recorded media stored as files; this entry evaluates the local MCP retrieval path.
searchDetail: FTS5 keyword search plus structured filters for time, app, window, speaker and tags; no semantic-search claim for the MCP path evaluated here.
storageDetail: Local history by default; optional Data Sync and team sharing add remote copies.
mcpDetail: Official screenpipe-mcp package; desktop Settings > Connections configures the bundled runtime and SCREENPIPE_LOCAL_API_KEY. A running Screenpipe instance is required.
toolSupportDetail: Connect a compatible MCP client to the local stdio server; the HTTP transport exposes a smaller tool surface.
scopesDetail: Local user history with time/app filters and namespaced person/project/topic tags; tags are retrieval filters, not isolation boundaries.
duplicateDetail: The audio database enforces uniqueness for identical transcription text within the same audio chunk. This is capture-level deduplication, not semantic merging of arbitrary memories.
retentionDetail: Manual range deletion and configurable age-based cleanup, with media-only, lean and all-data modes. Plan limits and external copies must be considered separately.
multiUserDetail: The default server is personal/local. Optional enterprise team tools query enrolled devices with separate team authentication.
crossMachineDetail: Optional Data Sync provides synced-devices and search-synced-content for the signed-in user; requires configuration and network access.
webUiDetail: Desktop Tauri app provides timeline, search and settings; not a standalone hosted memory-management web app.
tokenBudgetingDetail: search-content limits result count and truncates per-result text (default 1000 characters); this is not a tokenizer-based max_tokens guarantee.
contextInjectionDetail: The external assistant calls MCP tools to retrieve history or create/update persistent tagged memories.
networkDetail: Local capture/search can use local models. Cloud transcription, cloud AI, connected apps and sync send selected data off-device when used; telemetry has separate controls.
auditTrailDetail: Timestamped captures and optional source_context on memories support source inspection; no claim of immutable event sourcing or a complete memory-version chain.
pros: Retrieves screen and audio context across applications, including work outside the coding assistant
Timestamp, app, speaker and tag filters help narrow retrieved evidence
Official MCP integration with local API authentication
Local history storage and configurable retention
cons: Recording permissions and a running local app are required; storage use depends on capture and retention settings
Cloud assistant calls and optional sync can transmit retrieved context outside the device
Source is commercially licensed, not OSI open source; official desktop builds have separate terms and plan limits
